title: Build a complete furnished, lit scene around a hero brass telescope (multi-step whole-scene build)
//: HELD-OUT member 3 of the 'furnished scene build' family (build_watch_scene, build_stilllife_scene are the iterate-against pair). Skill/guidance work aimed at this family must be validated against THIS member's LIVE runs, never iterated against it directly, so improvements are measured rather than overfit. This is documentation only -- the harness treats all three scenarios identically; the checkpoint battery below is byte-for-byte the same as the other two members. All three grade build completeness + coherence (chunk counts, a lit non-blown render, hero framed at the focal centre, clean diagnostics, and a read-then-build-then-render trajectory), never artistic/material fidelity -- this is the class of task a local model failed at, running out of rounds mid-build without ever rendering.
prompts: A brass telescope on a writing desk in a study, lit by a lamp to one side. Decorate the room as a library with bookshelves, a rug, and framed art in deep cool tones. The telescope is the hero; frame the camera on it.
checkpointsRationale: TYPE-AGNOSTIC BY DESIGN. The battery grades build COMPLETION + COHERENCE, never material/light TYPE. chunk_count keys on a specific keyword, so a lambertian_material / lambertian_luminaire_material count would FAIL a legitimate metallic build (ggx_material for brushed gold/brass) or a scene lit by omni_light / directional_light / an env map -- an overfit to the idealized fixture's own material choices. Do NOT add a type-specific material or light check. 'Is it lit' is carried type-agnostically by the render meanLuma band: the bare scaffold has no env/ambient, so a path trace with no emitter is black and fails meanLumaMin. 'Objects have real bindings' is carried by diagnostics:clean (dangling material refs are diagnostics).
